authorization.scope: Maintainer acceptance for this release, the exact official rc.2 host manifest/lock and the ten listed advisories only.

expiry: A product/host identity or manifest/lock change, new advisory or unreviewed vulnerability facts invalidate this decision. Scanner and capture failures remain failures.
note: Reviewed reports contain the same ten direct advisories with 75 or 78 affected package entries. All report fields are bound except per-entry effects (derived reverse propagation) and fixAvailable (solver advice), whose shapes are validated and raw values retained. Package sets, via edges, installed node paths, ranges, advisory payloads and metadata remain exact. Other trees remain excluded.
